request: why does my birthday land one day later in the week each year?

beats.intent: A row of the seven weekdays with Monday lit as this year's birthday
beats.narration: This year your birthday is on a Monday.
beats.code:
stage.title("Birthday weekdays")
days = ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"]
row = VGroup(*[Rectangle(width=1.3, height=0.9, color=GREY_B) for _ in days]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1).move_to([0, 1.0, 0])
names = VGroup(*[Text(d, font_size=26).move_to(r) for d, r in zip(days, row)])
stage.play(Create(row), FadeIn(names))
stage.add(row, names)
stage.play(row[0].animate.set_fill(YELLOW, opacity=0.6))

beats.intent: A bar of 365 days split into 52 full weeks and 1 day left over
beats.narration: A year has three hundred and sixty five days: fifty two full weeks and one day more.
beats.code:
weeks = Rectangle(width=8.2, height=0.7, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.4).move_to([-0.5, -0.8, 0])
extra = Rectangle(width=0.4, height=0.7, color=RED, fill_opacity=0.7).next_to(weeks, RIGHT, buff=0)
stage.play(FadeIn(weeks), FadeIn(extra))
stage.add(weeks, extra)
stage.label(weeks, "52 weeks = 364 days", direction=DOWN, color=BLUE)
stage.label(extra, "+1", direction=DOWN, color=RED)

beats.intent: Tuesday lit as next year's birthday, beside 365 = 52 × 7 + 1
beats.narration: That spare day pushes your birthday one weekday later: Tuesday next year. After a leap day, it jumps two.

request: why is a kilobyte sometimes 1024 bytes?

beats.intent: Bars of powers of two from 2 to 1024
beats.narration: Computers count in twos: two, four, eight, doubling each time.
beats.code:
stage.title("Why 1024?")
b = draw_bars(stage, [2 ** k for k in range(1, 11)], labels=[str(k) for k in range(1, 11)], color=GREEN)
stage.caption("2 to the power 1 ... 10")

beats.intent: The tenth bar lit and labelled 1024, close to 1000
beats.narration: The tenth doubling lands on one thousand and twenty four, very close to a thousand.
beats.code:
bars = b[0] if len(b) == 2 else b
highlight(stage, bars[9], color=YELLOW)
stage.label(bars[9], "1024", direction=UP, color=YELLOW)

beats.narration: So a kilobyte, meant to be a thousand bytes, was often taken as two to the ten, the nearest power of two.

request: what does a 70% chance of rain actually mean?

beats.intent: Ten boxes for ten days with the same weather pattern
beats.narration: Imagine ten days with exactly this kind of weather.
beats.code:
stage.title("A 70% chance of rain")
boxes = VGroup(*[RoundedRectangle(width=1.0, height=1.0, corner_radius=0.15, color=GREY_B) for _ in range(10)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.15).move_to([0, 0.6, 0])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[Create(b) for b in boxes], lag_ratio=0.08))
stage.add(boxes)

beats.intent: Seven boxes filled blue with raindrops and three yellow for dry
beats.narration: On about seven of them it rains somewhere in the forecast area; on three it stays dry.
beats.code:
stage.play(*[b.animate.set_fill(BLUE if k < 7 else YELLOW, opacity=0.6) for k, b in enumerate(boxes)])
for k, b in enumerate(boxes):
    stage.add(Text("rain" if k < 7 else "dry", font_size=18).move_to(b))
stage.caption("7 of 10 such days: rain")

beats.narration: It doesn't mean it will rain for seventy percent of the day, or over seventy percent of the area.

request: if I drive there at 60 km/h and back at 40 km/h, is my average 50?

beats.intent: A road of 60 km with a car going there at 60 km/h taking 1 hour
beats.narration: The town is sixty kilometres away. Going there at sixty takes one hour.
beats.code:
stage.title("Average speed of a round trip")
road = Line([-5, 0.6, 0], [5, 0.6, 0], color=GREY_B)
stage.play(Create(road))
stage.add(road)
stage.label(road, "60 km", direction=UP)
car = Rectangle(width=0.7, height=0.35, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.9).move_to([-5, 0.85, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(car))
stage.play(car.animate.move_to([5, 0.85, 0]), run_time=1.0, rate_func=linear)
stage.add(car)
stage.caption("there: 60 km at 60 km/h = 1 hour")

beats.intent: The car coming back more slowly, taking 1.5 hours
beats.narration: Coming back at forty takes an hour and a half.
beats.code:
stage.play(car.animate.move_to([-5, 0.35, 0]), run_time=1.5, rate_func=linear)
stage.caption("back: 60 km at 40 km/h = 1.5 hours")

beats.intent: Bars of time: 1 h there and 1.5 h back, beside 120 km ÷ 2.5 h = 48 km/h
beats.narration: In all, a hundred and twenty kilometres in two and a half hours: forty eight, not fifty. You spend longer at the slow speed.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
b = draw_bars(stage, [1, 1.5], labels=["there", "back"], color=ORANGE)
stage.equation(r"\frac{120}{2.5} = 48\ \text{km/h}")
stage.caption("hours: 1 there, 1.5 back")
